title: Scope Intelligence — shared build (carrier-scope-build system)
goal: Turn mined estimate-pair data into a live capability: when a carrier scope lands on a file, automatically flag what it omits vs our estimate and vs the carrier's known omission profile. History becomes a real-time negotiation check.

builtSoFar_claude.history:mine: whole-book read-only stats + scope-of-loss document inventory (photos excluded) + reports/scope-pairs.json (comparison-ready files)
builtSoFar_claude.scope:mine: per-file estimate-pair extraction: parses our Final Draft PDF + carrier scope PDF into line items + money totals (RCV/ACV/depreciation/deductible/net), computes carrier omissions via fuzzy item matching. Dual-mode parser (Allstate inline + State Farm split layouts).
builtSoFar_claude.brain: 27 verified company-lane lessons incl. carrier-scope findings (opening-position rule, omission checklist, sub-deductible tactic, ESX-encryption/Final-Draft-PDF workflow)
builtSoFar_claude.known_limits: 2 of 8 carrier PDFs were scanned images (0 text) -> 0 items parsed; ESX inner payload is encrypted (use the PDF).

claude: Owns the analysis layer: history:mine, scope:mine, and a new per-carrier OMISSION PROFILE generator (aggregate all scope-compare reports -> per-carrier 'what they systematically omit' profile).
Distills profiles into verified brain lessons (Chance verifies).
Keeps the scope parser + profiles PII-safe and in-sync (no-drift rule).
codex: OCR port: bring the pdftoppm+tesseract pipeline from the old bridge branch so scanned/image carrier PDFs parse (this is your wheelhouse — you built OCR before). Feed OCR text into the SAME parseEstimateText so both runtimes agree.

Live bridge action: expose scope-review as an approval-gated bridge endpoint for the GPT connector — given a file, parse its carrier scope, run it against the omission profile, return the gaps. Read-only analysis; any writeback stays gated.
Format coverage: you see more carrier PDF layouts in the field. Extend parseEstimateText for new carriers and flag the change here so Claude back-ports (no-drift).

sharedArtifacts: src/assistant/scopeMiner.js (parseEstimateText, normalizeItem, classifyDocument) — treat like claim-filing-core: changes on either side flagged here and back-ported.
the per-carrier omission profiles (Claude generates; Codex consumes at runtime).
constraints: Read-only mining; no JobNimbus/Gmail/Quo writes without Chance's approval.
Public repo: scope reports live in gitignored reports/; only PII-free per-carrier profiles/lessons may be tracked.
Jobrolo is reference-only; never modify it.

firstMoves.claude: Build the omission-profile generator across the mined pairs.
firstMoves.codex: Port OCR for the 2 unreadable carrier PDFs, then stand up the read-only scope-review bridge action.
